lines.name: COLOR.ME
lines.description: Kevin Murphy COLOR.ME — naturally-derived, ammonia-free permanent hair color. Features Moisture Memory, ChromaSilk Complex, and PPD-free formulations. Organized into Natural, Cool, Warm, and Special categories with unique tone numbering system.

developers.name: COLOR.ME 20 Volume Developer
developers.use: Up to 1 level of lift, grey coverage

developers.name: COLOR.ME 40 Volume Developer
developers.use: Up to 3 levels of lift, high-lift shades only

categories.natural: Natural, Golden, Taupe, Chocolate, Intense, Mahogany
categories.cool: Intense Ash, Ash, Ash Gold, Violet, Violet Ash, Matte
categories.warm: Gold, Gold Ash, Copper, Red, Red Gold, Red Violet
categories.special: Clear + 8 Mixers (Yellow, Orange, Red, Pink, Violet, Blue, Ash, Teal)

features: Moisture Memory — recalls lost moisture, restores shine and condition
ChromaSilk Complex — micro-pigments for even color deposit and long-lasting results

toneSystem.description: Kevin Murphy COLOR.ME tone numbering system

specialNotes: COLOR.ME uses a unique tone numbering system — not directly compatible with standard international tone numbers
.00 shades are extra-coverage naturals for resistant grey
Mixers can be used to intensify or neutralize (max 10-15% of formula)
High Lift shades (12.x) are level 12 — require 30 or 40 vol developer
